organization.name: OrangeHRM Inc.
organization.notes: About page says founded 2005; leadership bio says co-founded Inc. in 2006, so founding history uses 2005 and incorporation date remains distinct. Historical Series A names Larry Stefanic and David Axmark. No current cap table published.

pricingTiers.name: Starter
pricingTiers.notes: GPL Starter software; infrastructure separate. Advanced functionality is a different commercial edition.
No explicit Most popular or Recommended designation verified on the official plan page; no plan inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Advanced
pricingTiers.notes: Per-employee-per-month, module selection and personalized quote. Officially available cloud or on-premises; no numeric rate published.
No separate Enterprise plan; Advanced is explicitly described as enterprise-grade and quoted per requirements.

moats.claim: A long-lived HR data model covering employee administration and time/leave workflows can create migration costs; paid Advanced remains a separate edition.

productReasons.claim: Employee database, profiles and corporate directory consolidate basic personnel information.
Leave requests and approvals work alongside time tracking for routine attendance administration.
Built-in recruitment and basic performance reviews cover more of the employee lifecycle in one HR application.

sponsorship.notes: No separate corporate financial/in-kind sponsor identified in reviewed official project and business pages. Verified commercial steward included as business fallback; customers, partners and investors are not classified as sponsors.

requirements.component: PHP 7.4 or PHP 8.x and required extensions
requirements.notes: v5.9 Composer constraint ^7.4|^8.0; PDO, curl, JSON, mbstring, zip, DOM, XML/simplexml, GD, LDAP and OpenSSL extensions. Constraint is software compatibility, not recommendation to use obsolete PHP.
Installer defaults to port3306/mysql schema; exact minimum database version not verified.
Official middleware guide supplies MariaDB route; no PostgreSQL/SQLite route verified.
Official middleware path uses Apache; other web servers not independently established.
Email delivery requires a mail provider; not required merely to run employee database.

requirements.condition: Building source rather than release package
requirements.notes: Bundled production dependencies differ from build tooling; no external Redis/cache/search service established.

resources.os: Linux; Windows installation route linked by official README
resources.notes: Only explicit documented hardware figures included; null means no minimum verified in reviewed installation source.

selfHosting.notes: Starter v5.9 source requirements checked; Linux/Windows prerequisites Help Center pages lacked usable body text, so versioned Composer and installer config plus official middleware guide used. No external Redis/queue/object-store service required by reviewed baseline.

oneClickInstall.notes: Reviewed official installation instructions; no current first-party or officially linked one-click or one-command installer verified. Manual package/Compose instructions excluded.
